summary: HypoExplorer compares HFD with chow in 15 wild-type males. The authors’ Supplementary Table S6 estimates the diet effect across those mice and 17 Gpr101 knockout males. The figures, all three supplements, GEO sample files and repository searches yielded no author-reported WT-only diet effect. The closure proposal and supporting evidence are saved for review.
openIssues: WT-specific author concordance remains unassessed. Reopen with an author-produced WT HFD-versus-chow result identifying the libraries and effect scale, or a documented author fit from which that contrast can be extracted.
